comments.body:
The same way we can watch entire this section as duplicate requirements - the keyword here is subcategory title - those are for service authentication, category 2.4 for end-user password storage.

In my opinion, if we need to improve here something, then more clear separation between requirements for users and requirements for services.

2.10.3 doesn't make any sense to me in this context and I think it is better covered in 2.10.4  I would support deleting as incorrect.
